nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Sit. Same chair. Still not a metaphor. I have seven possible evenings in my notes and only one of you. We will name which evening you actually lived.

faculty_interjections.text: She already knows. This is theatre with a grade.
Facts first. Feelings filed as facts.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wren flips a page. The page has opinions.

faculty_interjections.text: Match flags to the least flattering true ending.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: ink. Orth is compromised. We bleach the badge or bury it. Stationery budget weeps. You gave Clerk Moth a reason to believe in his job — never gift a zealot purpose.

faculty_interjections.text: Burned is recoverable. Pride is optional cargo.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: Maris Quell watched a logistics man become a security problem. That is not chemistry — that is a risk assessment she will finish without you. Taly will tell the story as farce. You are the punchline and the liability. Rubric: catastrophic competence theatre.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Dismissed. If you see Maris again, do not explain. Explanations are how ink spreads. Lower-third on the way out — if your face still remembers how.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: Sera Kade has the fragment. She will annotate it with a smile. We are late to our own dock window. I do not grade rivals, but if I did, she would be 'efficiently unbearable.'

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: you were busy being decent while she was busy being finished. Maris may respect the decency — she respects outcomes more. Do not confuse her keeping score with her keeping you. Rubric: moral velocity, operational last place.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Next time, be decent and fast, or admit you chose a ranking. Dismissed. Practice your lower-third — Sera already practiced hers on you.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: fragment secured. Voss's Friday window is ours to spoil. Cover held. Analysts will be employed; Sera will be annoyed. That is the correct emotional weather for a service.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: Taly still has a career because you spent minutes like a person. Maris noticed — not as a conquest, as a colleague who can split a problem without dumping the human half. She does not owe you affection for that. She may owe you a second conversation. Rubric: both ledgers breathing. Rare. Do not get addicted to rare.

faculty_interjections.text: Partner-shaped. Frame it. Don't wedding it.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: If Maris messages, tell me — secrets, not courtship. Dismissed. You may feel pride. Label it blood sugar and go home.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: green. Fragment. Cover. Voss timed to the toast. I could almost clap. I will not. Clapping is for audiences; we are inventory.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: you walked past Taly like weather with a badge. Maris will have the story by morning — not as romance failed, as a man who optimized the room and filed the people under noise. That is not an affection score. That is her closing a door. Rubric: spreadsheet with shoes. Mission loved you. Humans did not.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Keep the fragment. Lose the habit of calling people downstream. Dismissed before I prescribe smiling drills.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: empty pocket, full conscience. Sera has the cipher. The dock window is her problem now — and therefore still ours, only more expensive. Failure is data. This data has a receipt from the moral department.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: Maris kept the data of what you did for Taly. That is not a crush metric — that is a policy advisor filing evidence about who you are under pressure. She may never like you. She may still prefer you to the men who collect people. Rubric: logged as decent. Operationally irritating. Do not make a habit without telling me.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: We will work the gap Sera opened. You will not apologize for the person you saved — apologize for the minutes, if you must. Dismissed.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: uneven. Some intel, some restraint that cost spectacle. You did not audition for Voss's porcelain shelf. Cover likely held. Fragment status: contingent on what you actually pocketed while being a person.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: Maris Quell offered another ninety seconds as a hypothesis, not a promise. She has Observatory work that does not revolve around your cover. You treated her like that was true — finally. Perceived authenticity up. She is still not an affection meter. Rubric: human-shaped. Partial credit. Do not spend it on flowers.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: If she messages, you tell me — because secrets are mission-critical, not because I am your chaperone. Dismissed. Keep the parts where you were a person.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Professional column: mixed. Enough to justify a report, not enough to justify pride. Heat, hints, half-wins. I've seen worse from men who smile with their whole face.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Interpersonal: awkward, occasionally real, frequently wrong. Maris has incomplete data on you — which means she has not decided. Incomplete is not romance. Incomplete is unfinished surveillance with manners. Rubric: median spy weather. Honest, if unflattering.

nodes.speaker: wren_halden
nodes.text: Orth remains useful until he doesn't. Go home. Next time, pick a ledger and finish it — or finish both, if you insist on being difficult. Dismissed.
